autoDescription: Event → conditions → actions. Durable scheduling across restarts.
healthDescription: Specific problems with clear steps to fix them.
weeklyDescription: The previous completed week. The end date is exclusive.
adminRequired: Current server administrator permissions are required.
unavailable: Verification is unavailable. Please try again later.
failed: The operation failed. Check the values and permissions.
unsafeTarget: The channel or role is unavailable. Automations cannot grant staff or privileged roles.
name: Name
placeholders: Available: {user} and {server}. Mentions do not send notifications.
matched: Conditions match. No Discord changes were made.
unmatched: Conditions do not match. No Discord changes were made.
dryHint: A test run only validates. All conditions must match in a live run; permissions are checked again.
noJobs: No runs yet. New rules become active within 30 seconds.
removeConfirm: Delete this rule? Pending runs will also be cancelled.
jobHelp: On failure, check the author’s admin access, bot hierarchy and channel permissions. Interrupted runs are not replayed automatically because some actions may have completed.
missingChannel: A configured channel could not be found.
missingRole: A configured role could not be found.
roleHierarchy: The bot cannot assign this role.
channelPermissions: The bot is missing permissions in this channel.
fixSettings: Select an existing channel or role in settings.
fixRole: Server Settings → Roles: place the bot role above the role to assign. Integration roles cannot be assigned.
fixChannel: Edit Channel → Permissions: allow the bot to view the channel, send messages and embed links. Also check role overrides.
recommendActivity: Messages decreased: try a community event or daily conversation starter.
recommendRetention: More members left than joined: review your welcome flow and first steps.
recommendSupport: Average first ticket response exceeds an hour: review staff notifications and workload.
noRecommendation: No notable issues in the measured data.
noData: Activity tracking does not have enough data for this week. Missing measurements do not mean zero activity.
weeklySchedule: Optional delivery on Mondays after 08:00 in the bot’s timezone. Only completed weeks are summarized.
alreadyDecided: This appeal has already been decided.
unlinked: User appeal, not yet linked to a specific case.
decisionHint: Recording a decision does not lift the sanction. Perform the required moderation action separately.
